fact: A study of Bassar 1 using administrative accounts for 2020 to 2024 found the taxpayer database very limited and taxpayers not geolocated, the GesFiCo digitisation project unfinished, and 72% of 128 surveyed taxpayers not registered.
title: Status of the Tax Resource Mobilization System in the Municipality of Bassar 1 in Togo: Innovative Implications for Local Development
